from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class HousingMonthRecord(BaseModel):
    """A monthly housing start data point extracted from a single report."""
    month: str | None = Field(description="The month covered by this data point (YYYY-MM)")
    total_housing_starts_saar: float | None = Field(description="Seasonally Adjusted Annual Rate for Total Housing Starts")
    single_family_housing_starts_saar: float | None = Field(description="Seasonally Adjusted Annual Rate for Single-Family Housing Starts")
    report_release_date: str | None = Field(description="The date the report containing this data was released (YYYY-MM-DD), used for precedence resolution")
    report_identifier: str | None = Field(description="Identifier for the source document (e.g., CB number or Document ID)")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    housing_data_points: list[HousingMonthRecord]
